import collections.abc

              "Hashable", "MutableSet", "Set", "Container", "OrderedDict",

    if not hasattr(collections, _name) and hasattr(collections.abc, _name):
        setattr(collections, _name, getattr(collections.abc, _name))

import sys
import pytest
sys.exit(pytest.main(sys.argv[1:]))

import collections, collections.abc
for n in ("Mapping","MutableMapping","Sequence","Iterable","Callable","Hashable"):
    if not hasattr(collections, n): setattr(collections, n, getattr(collections.abc, n))
from sympy import Basic, Integer, Float, Rational, oo, zoo, nan
from sympy.core.numbers import Number

# 1. Issue use case: Foo unaware of Basic, symmetric == via delegation
class Foo():
    def __eq__(self, other):
        if isinstance(other, Basic):
            return True
        return NotImplemented
    def __ne__(self, other):
        return not self == other

s = Basic(); f = Foo()
assert s == f and f == s, "symmetric == with Basic"
assert not (s != f) and not (f != s)
print("OK: Basic == Foo symmetric (delegation works)")

# 2. Unknown type on both sides -> False, no crash
class Unaware: pass
b = Basic()
assert (b == Unaware()) is False and (Unaware() == b) is False
assert b != Unaware()
print("OK: both-NotImplemented falls back to False")

# 3. Raw __eq__ returns NotImplemented singleton for unknown types
assert b.__eq__(Unaware()) is NotImplemented
assert Integer(3).__eq__(Unaware()) is NotImplemented
assert Float(1.0).__eq__(Unaware()) is NotImplemented
